create_offloading_connector: create an OffloadingConnector instance with vllm config, role, and kv cache config for KV cache offloading
build_kv_connector_stats: build OffloadingConnectorStats from optional data dict for offloading connector metrics
build_prom_metrics: build OffloadPromMetrics with vllm config, metric types, label names, and per-engine label values
build_connector_meta: build OffloadingConnectorMetadata from scheduler output for KV cache offloading scheduling
shutdown_offloading_connector: shutdown the OffloadingConnector by shutting down its scheduler and worker components
